summary:
Household: New York, owns home, about $65,000/year from work, one son (age not confirmed). Marital status and whether anyone has job-based health insurance could not be confirmed after repeated questions, so a caseworker should verify these.

Recommended to apply:
- Child Tax Credit (refundable part): son is a child under 18 and income is within range.
- CHIP (NY Child Health Plus) for the son: income is well under the child limit.
- School meals: New York has universal free school meals, so the son should qualify at school.
- ACA premium tax credit: likely eligible at this income if no one has job-based health insurance. Caseworker to confirm, since job coverage would rule it out.

Not recommended: SNAP, WIC (no pregnancy or infant reported; income too high), TANF, SSI (no disability reported), Medicaid for adults and EITC (income above limits).
